paragraph: [Angop reports that the Mbanza Kongo maternity has issued newborns their first Bilhete de Identidade since October 2025](<https://angop.ao/noticias/politica/zaire-mbanza-kongo-inicia-registo-de-recem-nascidos-a-partir-da-maternidade/>), under the Nascer com Registo project. [Biometric Update said in November 2025 that Angola was beginning to issue ID cards to newborns at maternity wards](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202511/angola-begins-issuance-of-id-cards-to-newborns>). [The Justice Minister says the plan's second phase provides for the BI at birth in maternity hospitals](<https://angop.ao/noticias/politica/impressao-do-bi-abrange-todas-as-provincias-do-pais/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says every registered birth across the country receives the number. Operating would need every birth registered in the country to receive the number, the birth record creating the identity record.

[In July 2024 interior ministry officials said the ID for D project records each person electronically from birth](<https://burundi-eco.com/la-digitalisation-des-services-publics-un-besoin-urgent/>). [The ministry's permanent secretary said the number will be given at a health facility or by the civil-status officer](<https://mininterinfos.gov.bi/vers-une-identification-sure-et-securisee/>). The first phase covers eleven communes. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a child has received the number in any part of the country. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.

[The identity agency ANIP says every birth declared since 1 April 2021 gives the child an NPI](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T4-1-S2-3-Benin-FINAL.pdf>), the personal number. The birth certificate is then generated automatically. [Since August 2025 ten health facilities have registered births at the maternity itself](<https://www.unicef.org/benin/recits/le-b%C3%A9nin-modernise-lenregistrement-des-naissances-avec-un-guichet-unique-digital>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 puts birth registration at all births and deaths at 80% or more. Mature would need birth registration to reach all births, each given the number, and death registration of 80% or more.

[In October 2024 the digital ministry reported that deputies had approved the unique electronic identification of persons](<https://www.mdenp.gov.bf/details?cHash=33c705c5a2e4a9768ead889848f29c15&tx_news_pi1%5Baction%5D=detail&tx_news_pi1%5Bcontroller%5D=News&tx_news_pi1%5Bnews%5D=808>). The minister said the identifier is a random number. It is to be given to every Burkinabe from birth, at home or abroad. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says a child has yet received the number at birth registration. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.

[In August 2026 Statistics Botswana said the National Identification System gives every citizen child a unique birth registration number at birth](<https://statsbots.org.bw/sites/default/files/publications/Vital%20Statistics%20Report%202024.pdf>). [The number becomes the Omang number at age 16](<https://statsbots.org.bw/sites/default/files/publications/Vital%20Statistics%20Report%202024.pdf>). [The number was introduced in 2003](<https://statsbots.org.bw/sites/default/files/publications/Vital%20Statistics%20Report%202024.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 puts birth registration at all births and deaths at 80% or more. Mature would need birth registration to reach all births, each given the number, and death registration of 80% or more.

[In June 2025 the head of ONECI, Côte d'Ivoire's identity office, said the work was under way](<https://digitalmag.ci/ago-christian-kodia-le-numero-national-didentification-nni-est-lelement-principal-de-la-digitalisation-de-lidentite/>). That work is to give newborns their national identification number (NNI) in maternity wards. [In September 2026 he said a campaign would soon create identities on digital terminals on the day of birth](<https://digitalmag.ci/id-day-2026-promesse-dune-identite-legale-et-numerique-a-chaque-citoyen-en-cote-divoire/>). In the last twelve months that campaign was announced, where in June 2025 he had said only that the work was under way. No source found says newborns now receive the NNI at birth registration. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.

[In December 2024 Cameroon's law 2024/016 instituted a unique personal identification number (NIPU), a MINDDEVEL presentation said](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/PS5A-S1-3-Cameroun_FINAL.pdf>). That law provided for attributing the NIPU. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says children receive a number when their birth is registered. The presentation does not say the NIPU is given at birth registration. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.

[In August 2026 the AMECC project said the Comoros civil registration system still depends largely on old paper registers](<https://lagazettedescomores.com/soci%C3%A9t%C3%A9/%C3%A9tat-civil-l%E2%80%99amecc-veut-enterrer-les-registres-sur-papier-.html>). [Some people, including children, still had no birth extract in 2026](<https://lagazettedescomores.com/soci%C3%A9t%C3%A9/%C3%A9tat-civil-l%E2%80%99amecc-veut-enterrer-les-registres-sur-papier-.html>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a number at birth is provided for or piloted. Preparing would need a law or programme that provides for a unique ID number at birth, or a pilot in some districts or facilities.

[In May 2026 Biometric Update said every child born in Cabo Verde receives a Unique Identification Number at birth](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202605/cabo-verdes-crvs-id-reforms-drive-near-universal-birth-registration>). [In May 2026 birth registration stood at 99% after the reforms](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202605/cabo-verdes-crvs-id-reforms-drive-near-universal-birth-registration>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No figure for death registration has been found. No source found since October 2023 puts birth registration at all births and deaths at 80% or more. Mature would need birth registration to reach all births, each given the number, and death registration of 80% or more.

[In 2024 the Ministry of Digital Affairs said the National Identification Number is attributed from birth](<https://numerique.gouv.dj/Articles/detailArticleAvancee/15>). [It goes to any person entered in a civil register](<https://numerique.gouv.dj/Articles/detailArticleAvancee/15>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The ministry's statement says whom the number is for. No source found since October 2023 shows every registered birth across the country receiving it. Operating would need every birth registered in the country to receive the number, the birth record creating the identity record.

[Algeria's Ministry of Interior says each newborn has received its own birth certificate and unique national identifier (NIN) once registered, since 2018](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-decentralisation-algeria.pdf>). It said so in a July 2026 presentation on the digitisation of civil registration. The presentation says the NIN is generated automatically from the national automated civil register (RNAEC). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 puts birth registration at all births and deaths at 80% or more. Mature would need birth registration to reach all births, each given the number, and death registration of 80% or more.

[In March 2025 a Fayda official told BBC Amharic that children collecting a birth certificate at school can take a Fayda number at the same time](<https://www.bbc.com/amharic/articles/c204dl15p96o>). This covers some children in Addis Ababa. Children under five are registered with a parent as witness. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the number is given at birth registration outside Addis Ababa, or how many children have received it. Operating would need every birth registered in the country to receive the number, the birth record creating the identity record.

[Vice President Bawumia launched the Ghana Card number at birth system on 14 March 2024](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/bawumia-launches-ghana-card-number-at-birth/>). It generated a number for the baby at health-facility birth registration. [The programme was suspended after a technical fault](<https://theoverseeronline.com/infant-registration/>). In the last twelve months, [on 11 August 2026 the NIA tested a renewed application to register children aged 0-5](<https://theoverseeronline.com/infant-registration/>) at selected health facilities. No source found says children have received the number since the suspension. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.

[Guinea's territorial administration ministry launched the national civil-status register project, RENEC, on 28 October 2026](<https://guistat.com/guinee-le-matd-lance-via-loneci-le-projet-renec-pour-moderniser-et-securiser-letat-civil/>). It works through ONECI, the national identification office. The register is to record civil-status events from birth, and each citizen in it is to have a unique identifier number. [The PN-RAVEC census launched in April 2025 also rests on an identifier given at birth and kept for life](<https://guineenews.org/2025/04/22/etat-civil-aucun-document-didentite-navait-de-base-legale-selon-djenabou-toure/>). In the last twelve months RENEC was launched. No source found since October 2023 says children receive a number when their birth is registered. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.

[The World Bank says the eCRVS issues birth certificates each carrying a unique national identification number, generated in real time at registration](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/03/28/afw-transformative-journey-of-mass-birth-registration-and-health-insurance-in-the-gambia>). [It did so in a mass registration campaign from August 2022 to February 2023, reported in 2024](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/03/28/afw-transformative-journey-of-mass-birth-registration-and-health-insurance-in-the-gambia>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says every registered birth across the country receives the number. Operating would need every birth registered in the country to receive the number, the birth record creating the identity record.

[In May 2026 the PS said every child will be issued the Maisha Number at birth](<https://nation.africa/kenya/news/inside-new-reforms-to-curb-birth-certificate-fraud-5463104>). In the last twelve months, [on 6 October 2026 PS Belio Kipsang said birth e-notification would reach SHA-contracted hospitals by December](<https://www.kenyans.co.ke/news/127644-state-expand-digital-birth-registration-sha-hospitals-within-3-months>). In November 2026 he told MPs the number had been [piloted through electronic birth notification in Nairobi City County and Bomet County](<https://nation.africa/kenya/news/how-kenya-s-digital-birth-registration-system-will-work--5663174>). No source found since October 2023 says children receive the number at birth registration beyond that pilot. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.

[The Liberian Investigator reports that the NIR changed its system in June 2023](<https://liberianinvestigator.com/nir-partners-launch-national-id-documents-for-children-under-six/>). [It now assigns unique identification numbers to children under six](<https://liberianinvestigator.com/nir-partners-launch-national-id-documents-for-children-under-six/>). [The programme, called Enrolment at Birth, has a pilot in Montserrado, Grand Bassa and Gbarpolu](<https://liberianinvestigator.com/nir-partners-launch-national-id-documents-for-children-under-six/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says children receive a number when their birth is registered. The enrolment is run by the NIR and is separate from birth registration. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.

[In July 2026 Lesotho's NICR said a unique personal identification number is issued upon birth registration](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-interoperability-lesotho.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says every registered birth across the country receives the number. No source found since October 2023 puts birth registration at all births and deaths at 80% or more. Operating would need every birth registered in the country to receive the number, the birth record creating the identity record.

[In October 2025 Hespress said Law 36-21 provides for a national digital platform with a civil and social identifier](<https://fr.hespress.com/447050-interieur-les-walis-sommes-daccelerer-la-numerisation-de-letat-civil.html>). [The identifier is assigned to every birth, Moroccan or foreign resident](<https://fr.hespress.com/447050-interieur-les-walis-sommes-daccelerer-la-numerisation-de-letat-civil.html>). [In 2024 CRVS Laws said Article 30 of the law assigns the identifier at birth registration, but only to citizens](<https://www.crvslaws.org/morocco/birth-registration/id-related-services>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says children receive a number when their birth is registered. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.

The World Bank's PRODIGY project reports that its [pilot in Antananarivo and Toamasina had registered over 3,000 newborns by October 2023](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099122123130031407/pdf/P1694131558e640e51a145152595653587b.pdf>). Each was issued a birth certificate copy carrying a unique identification number. In January 2025 [Newsmada reported that the Cneci project aims to deliver birth certificates with a unique biometric identification number](<https://newsmada.com/2025/01/20/etat-civil-et-identite-nationale-lancement-des-activites-du-cneci/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says every birth registered across the country receives the number. Operating would need every birth registered in the country to receive the number, the birth record creating the identity record.

No stage is set. No source found since 2023 says whether registering a birth in Mali gives an identity number. The civil registry's 2026 account of paper village notebooks covers remote areas only. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying a birth creates no identity record, because registration and ID are separate or registration is on paper only.

[The Civil Status Division's database generates a unique identification number for each citizen at birth registration](<https://prb.govmu.org/prb/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/csd.pdf>). A 2024 Pay Research Bureau report says so. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says every registered birth across the country receives the number. None says how many births and deaths are registered. Operating would need every birth registered in the country to receive the number, the birth record creating the identity record.

[In November 2024 a registration team lead said an ID number is generated for a child at birth](<https://pedaids.org/2024/11/06/the-value-of-a-birth-certificate/>). The same number is printed on the card at 16. [The Principal Secretary says children under 16 get birth registration certificates with a unique identification number](<https://mwnation.com/nrb-under-scrutiny/>). [The National Registration Bureau reports successful registration of 3.5 million births with unique identifiers](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/PS1-S1-5-Malawi-final.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says every registered birth across the country receives the number. Operating would need every birth registered in the country to receive the number, the birth record creating the identity record.

[On 15 April 2025 the Ministry of the Interior launched a pilot in four communes](<https://www.wuri.ne/etat-civil-wuri-lancement-officiel-des-operations-denregistrement-des-enfants-de-moins-de-5-ans/>). [It registers children under five and issues them a unique identifier number with a new birth certificate](<https://www.wuri.ne/etat-civil-wuri-lancement-officiel-des-operations-denregistrement-des-enfants-de-moins-de-5-ans/>). [About 4 million children are targeted over three phases](<https://www.wuri.ne/etat-civil-wuri-lancement-officiel-des-operations-denregistrement-des-enfants-de-moins-de-5-ans/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says children receive a number when their birth is registered. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.

[In September 2024 a civil registration official said a NIN is generated for each child during registration](<https://blueprint.ng/birth-registration-npc-introduces-nin-integration-for-newborns-linked-to-mothers/>). It is tied to the mother's record. [In September 2025 the population commission said the NIN is built into its e-CRVS system](<http://www.nationalpopulation.gov.ng/news/npc-chairman-joins-stakeholders-to-celebrate-the-7th-national-day-of-identity-in-abuja>). [UNICEF said in June 2026 that the aim is a NIN for every child from birth](<https://data.unicef.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/A-Statistical-Profile-of-Birth-Registration-in-Nigeria_final-June-2026.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says every registered birth across the country receives the number. Operating would need every birth registered in the country to receive the number, the birth record creating the identity record.

[A 2026 deck says the June 2023 law provides for a number from birth](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-1-Rwanda-FINAL.pdf>). Enrolment was piloted in the Southern Province from October 2025, with numbers planned from October 2026. [In June 2024 the identity agency's head had said the agency now issues identity from birth](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202406/legal-reforms-adapted-to-tech-changes-data-safeguards-vital-for-expanding-digital-id-reach>). No change has been found in the last twelve months: [in September 2026 the new card was still described as coming](<https://radiotv10.rw/en/over-7-2-million-rwandans-complete-biometric-enrolment-for-electronic-ids/>). No source found since 2024 says a child has received the new number. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.

[In December 2023 Chad's digital birth register, TASDJIL, ran desks in more than 50 maternity units](<https://tchadinfos.com/2023/12/10/societe-la-digitalisation-des-actes-de-naissance-une-transformation-cruciale-pour-letat-civil-au-tchad/>). It puts a national identification number (NNI) on new birth certificates. Older certificates carry no NNI. [In July 2025 the Mongo hospital desk was registering 10 to 15 births a day, each with an NNI](<https://ndarason.com/tchad-la-digitalisation-accelere-lenregistrement-des-naissances-a-mongo/>). In the last twelve months, [a desk at Koukou Angarana hospital was also reported giving children an NNI in August 2026](<https://www.atpe.td/etat-civil-au-tchad-des-reformes-pour-les-enfants-non-enregistres/>). No source found since October 2023 says every registered birth across the country receives the number. Operating would need every birth registered in the country to receive the number, the birth record creating the identity record.

[In May 2026 the playbook said the unique citizen identifier (IUC) is given at birth](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-2-Tunisia-FINAL.pdf>). [It said this covers every person entered in the civil status register](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-2-Tunisia-FINAL.pdf>). [The deck says the 11-digit non-significant unique number was set up by decree-law of 12 May 2020](<https://id4africa.com/2024/ps3/PS3-3-Tunisia-Final.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 puts birth registration at all births and deaths at 80% or more. Mature would need birth registration to reach all births, each given the number, and death registration of 80% or more.

[In September 2026 the NIDA Director said a plan to register children with NIDA from birth was under pilot](<https://www.thecitizen.co.tz/tanzania/news/national/why-your-nida-number-is-more-than-just-a-numeral-5598108>). [The pilot is in three districts](<https://www.thecitizen.co.tz/tanzania/news/national/why-your-nida-number-is-more-than-just-a-numeral-5598108>). [The Home Affairs Minister said preparations are underway to register children so that every Tanzanian has a National Identification Number](<https://dailynews.co.tz/unclaimed-ids-law-in-offing/>). A legal framework is being prepared. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says children receive a number when their birth is registered. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.

[Uganda's National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA) said in July 2026 that the NIN is issued automatically once a birth notification is made](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-interoperability-uganda.pdf>). [No biometrics are needed for a child of 9 months or under](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-interoperability-uganda.pdf>). [NIRA says about 636,000 children have been enrolled](<https://www.monitor.co.ug/uganda/news/national/21-million-ugandans-transferred-to-new-nira-system-as-registration-drive-intensifies-5318862>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says every registered birth across the country receives the number. Operating would need every birth registered in the country to receive the number, the birth record creating the identity record.

[In November 2025 Home Affairs told Parliament that a child whose birth is registered through a health facility gets a birth certificate on the spot](<https://pmg.org.za/committee-question/33804/>). An ID number is allocated at that registration and stays with the child for life. The department described this as a single entry point into the National Population Register. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says every birth registered in the country receives the number. Operating would need every birth registered in the country to receive the number, the birth record creating the identity record.

[In October 2023 the INRIS deputy project manager said persons will be allocated a legal identity number at birth registration](<https://dailynationzambia.com/2023/10/govt-digitises-nrcs/>). [The number is to be their citizenship identifier for life](<https://dailynationzambia.com/2023/10/govt-digitises-nrcs/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says children receive a number when their birth is registered, in any part of the country. Establishing would need children to receive a unique ID number when their birth is registered, in at least part of the country.
